17	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.audit;
18	
19	import org.slf4j.Logger;
20	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
21	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
22	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
23	
24	/**
25	 * Writes owner-lifecycle audit records to the dedicated {@code AUDIT} logger, keeping the
26	 * audit trail decoupled from the application's diagnostic logging. Each successful owner
27	 * creation produces a single line carrying the identifying facts of the new record.
28	 */
29	@Component
30	public class OwnerAuditLogger {
31	
32	    private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
33	
34	    /**
35	     * Emits an audit line for a newly created owner, recording its id, customer code,
36	     * registration date and membership level.
37	     *
38	     * @param owner the persisted owner (must already have an assigned id)
39	     */
40	    public void logCreated(Owner owner) {
41	        AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
42	            owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), owner.getMembershipLevel());
43	    }
44	}
